cards.title: Comprehensive 3NF Schema & V1-V13 Migrations
items: V1 Baseline: 27 relational tables structured in Strict 3NF with BIGINT surrogate identity primary keys and UNIQUE natural business keys.
V6 & V7: rental_contract decouples storage_unit_id to nullable for PENDING check-in assignment, adding scheduled_start_time and scheduled_end_time windows.

V10 & V13: Telesales CRM waitlist table added with direct contact_phone and conversion foreign keys to reservation and rental_contract; unit_type enriched with SKU dimensions (pallet_capacity, max_load_kg_m2, environment, features).
V12: app_user protected against checkout spam with daily_cancel_count and last_cancel_date per rule BR-SPAM-01.

cards.title: Relationship Cardinality & Optionality
items: Strict 1:1 business constraints: rental_contract enforces uq_rental_contract_reservation_id, contract_renewal enforces uq_contract_renewal_payment_transaction_id, and handover_record enforces uq_handover_record_contract_id.

Deferred & Optional Foreign Keys (drawn dashed): storage_unit_id on reservation and contract is optional prior to unit assignment; waitlist conversion links (converted_reservation_id, converted_contract_id) are nullable.
Audit & Polymorphic Relationships: audit_log, support_request, and attachment support polymorphic entity linkage across system operations.

cards.title: 6 Subsystem Domain Architecture
items: identity_access (6 tables): User authentication, RBAC authorization, anti-spam quota, OTP verification, and system audit logs.
facility_catalog (5 tables): Facility infrastructure, SKU unit types, physical storage units, smart lock credentials, and access logs.
pricing_policy (6 tables): System policies, monthly pricing snapshots, historic price versions, extra fee catalog, and promotions.
rental_lifecycle (6 tables): Telesales CRM waitlist, reservation holds, active contracts, renewals, check-in handovers, and return checkouts.
billing_ledger (4 tables): Payment transactions with PayOS gateway, double-entry financial ledger entries, extra charges, and fee waivers.
operations_support (3 tables): Customer support tickets with SLA tracking, daily staff task dispatches, and evidence attachments.
